task.title: Configure browser access and defaults
task.shortdesc: Use Step 1 to configure browser behavior, network access, and search without duplicating URL or site controls.

prereq.p: A saved profile is open in Guided editor.

context.p: Browser, network, and search collects browser behavior, network access, and search controls. Homepage, startup, site filters, handlers, and managed bookmarks belong only to Step 2.

step.cmd: Open Step 1, Browser, network, and search.

info.p: Expected result: only this domain's controls are visible.

step.cmd: Review browser behavior, network access, and search controls for the deployment.

info.p: Expected result: network and search choices are intentional.

step.cmd: Open Step 2 for homepage or site-navigation controls rather than recreating them here.

info.p: Expected result: each URL/site policy has one Guided owner.

step.cmd: Validate warnings shown next to schema-dependent controls.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile has intentional browser access and default-behavior settings.

postreq.p: Recovery: if validation flags a value, undo the last change or use All settings to inspect the raw policy shape. Use Step 2 when the affected value is a URL, site, handler, or managed bookmark.
